title: THE SNARE IS BROKEN
GOD IS YOUR ESCAPE
end: The Covenant Shield — walk under God's daily covering

scenes.a: The trap set against your peace is broken.
scenes.sub: THE TRAP AGAINST YOU IS BROKEN

scenes.a: You were not handed over to the thing that sought to consume you today.
Hear the word of God in Psalm 124: Blessed be the LORD, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.
Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.
Our help is in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
scenes.sub: OUR HELP IS IN HIS NAME

scenes.a: Lord, break every subtle net of fear and hidden trap plotted against this life.
You are our refuge; pull our feet from the dark cables of anxiety.
Amen. The trap set against your peace is broken.
